news.headline: Russian missiles kill 17 more in Ukraine as Guterres calls for ceasefire
news.summary: Russian ballistic missile strikes killed 17 people and injured more than 40 in and around the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Thursday, local authorities reported.

news.headline: Middle East: 94 per cent need shelter in Gaza, Israel ramps up demolitions in Lebanon
news.summary: Ninety-four cent of Gaza’s 2.1 million residents need shelter as Israeli gunfire and strikes continue inside the enclave, UN agencies and peacekeepers warned on Thursday.

news.headline: As elections near, South Sudan risks new atrocity crimes, warns rights probe
news.summary: The under-reported humanitarian crisis in South Sudan risks deepening with the real possibility of further atrocity crimes unless renewed fighting stops, a UN-backed probe said on Thursday.

news.headline: Mpox: Children account for half of suspected cases in Guinea-Bissau
news.summary: Children, who are particularly vulnerable to the disease, account for half of the 46 suspected mpox cases identified in Guinea-Bissau – with 16 of them under the age of four.

news.headline: DR Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses as Bundibugyo outbreak spreads
news.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine from the UN’s international vaccine coordination group (ICG) to protect frontline communities against the Ebola virus disease.

news.headline: Colombia earthquake: 1.2 million need aid as some communities remain out of reach
news.summary: Ten days after a powerful earthquake struck western Colombia, an estimated 1.2 million people need humanitarian assistance, while some communities have still received little or no aid, UN agencies said on Thursday.
